changes: When an action (REC HLD or REC TGL) ends live recording, the Rytm is back in the record mode it was in before live recording started: grid recording or step recording, through stock's own setters, whether live recording started from the input or from the panel's RECORD + PLAY. From play mode it still ends in play mode. The audio path is unchanged.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
